name: sequence_graph_v1
feature_variant: DISK on overlapping 1024px tiles at native nadir resolution; <=2048 spatially distributed features; LightGlue

joint_fit.model: planar homography pose graph, target fixed to identity

comparison: Original pairwise baseline; tiled features with original pairwise geometry; tiled features with joint sequence geometry. Same target masks, donor masks and fusion policies.
limits: No measured camera calibration or full 3D road model yet
Homographies jointly share a reference plane, not physical metric ground truth
Graph holdout is correspondence validation, not under-car ground truth
The same nine scenes are development after repeated iteration
hypothesis: Longer temporal context and a deduplicated union of learned features and trajectory-seeded tracking connect weak target observations.
annotation_review: Eleven-frame contact sheets visually checked; original vehicle and conservative main-road ground masks reused for all added frames. Original evaluation masks unchanged.

matching.tracking: same masked GPS-initialized LK as v2
matching.deduplication: 8px source cells; learned features retained first

controls: same eleven images and correspondences with pairwise geometry
limitations: Eleven consecutive frames, not full capture-collection SfM
Single road plane; metadata is only a search prior
Same roads are development; no actual footprint ground truth
